notes: Original PNGs were reviewed without resizing or conversion; hashes identify the local reviewed artifacts. Selected originals are hosted for the PR walkthrough.
After captures have identical production components, translations and navigation inventory to reviewed source; the subsequent source commit changes fixtures/capture and test query typing.

Before uses seven T3 captures with unconfirmed requested viewport and different raster scale; all other images use Playwright Chromium full-page capture. Comparison is semantic, not pixel-for-pixel. Full-page height may exceed CSS viewport height.
Fixtures render actual production components with synthetic data/providers; backend writes and AI calls refuse. Camera is deliberately denied or uses an explicitly synthetic canvas stream.
R17, R18 and R19 use baseline source and caller-test evidence rather than new visual captures.
No authenticated-production timing, physical-camera or external-provider verification is claimed.
